[Process description]
[Additional information (e.g., author, contact information and applications involved and required external setup)]#/
SET PathToConfig TO $'''C:\\Users\\dusanku\\Desktop\\Process Configurations\\Framework Folder Setup\\Config.xlsx'''
DISABLE CALL Framework_TestBench
CALL Framework_InitAllSettings
SET LogLevel TO $'''Info'''
SET LogMessage TO $'''Process started'''
CALL Framework_LogMessage
CALL Framework_KillAllProcesses
CALL Framework_InitAllApplications
CALL Framework_GetTransactionData
LABEL SetTransactionItem
CALL Framework_SetTransactionItem
IF IsNotEmpty(TransactionItem) THEN
    BLOCK ProcessException
ON BLOCK ERROR all
    CALL Framework_ProcessErrorHandler
END
        CALL Framework_Process
    END
    CALL Framework_SetTransactionStatus
    GOTO SetTransactionItem
ELSE
    GOTO EndProcess
END
LABEL EndProcess
CALL Framework_CloseAllApplications
SET LogLevel TO $'''Info'''
SET LogMessage TO $'''Process finished'''
CALL Framework_LogMessage
